7) Driver: Integral SMPS-based LED driver with output short-circuit protection. 8) Construction/Material: Ultra-slim co-extruded polycarbonate channel with housing in white finish. 9) Power Factor: ≥ 0.90. 10) Marking: Manufacturer's/brand name shall be permanently engraved/embossed on the luminaire. 11) Test Report & BIS Certification: The bidder shall submit a valid test report conforming to IS 103 22 (Part 5/Sec 2):2012 or latest applicable revision/amendment thereof for the offered product al ong with the offer and with the supplies.
